service: return the newest provider-held immutable bundle for each exact customer-declared source URL
preconditions: the customer supplies one to eight exact HTTP or HTTPS source URLs
the provider previously acquired each returned bundle through its source-bundle refresh service
the offer binds the exact provider-held snapshot returned by invocation
postconditions: the returned delivery contains only exact provider-held bundle values and canonical digests
the delivery and provider receipt bind the requested URL set and returned snapshot
the provider performs no network fetch and no customer-territory write
prohibitions: no claim that recalled evidence is fresh merely because it was recalled
no URL discovery, writing, editing, or publication
